evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: A definitional contrast that controls the conceptual frame — supplying the authoritative distinction the reader is meant to adopt.

evidence.quote: The substrate is a commodity; the perspective is the asset you keep.

observations.why: Reframes the landscape by supplying a conceptual hierarchy (commodity vs. asset) and arguing from that logic — informational control plus rational persuasion.
